title: 第65章 去乡里卖肉了
content_zh:
第65章 去乡里卖肉了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

存书签

“五块钱还不行？”

“李青山，你这是狮子大张口啊，七块，七块钱成不成？”

赵瞎子一咬牙，再次加了两块钱，只觉得心疼无比，两块钱啊，，一斤烧锅酒才一块钱一斤，一斤红糖才六毛，一斤猪肉才四毛啊！！

“十块钱，少一分都不成！”

李青山摇了摇头道。

赵瞎子家里有钱，这是李青山没想到的，原本以为赵瞎子是个穷光蛋，就想着直接送去劳动教养，没想到这家伙还能掏出钱来？

既如此，那就好好压榨压榨。

自己现在也正缺钱，能压榨出十块钱，也确实不错了，要是要的太多了，赵瞎子肯定直接一狠心去劳动教养了，而且周公安刚刚也是故意说重了一点。

这种事情未遂，没有伤，其实两三个月劳动教养才是大概率的。

但是，今天的事情，可不算完！

赵瞎子这货，必须要好好整治一番才行。

“憋什么屁，赶紧答应！”

赵支书一脚踹在赵瞎子屁股上，语气威严的怒斥道。

赵瞎子只要不被带走，自己面子还算没有掉到地上，这个时候还磨磨蹭蹭干什么，赶紧赔钱就是了，反正赔的也不是自己的钱。

“好好好，十块钱，就十块钱！”

赵瞎子一咬牙，在半年劳动教养的恐惧下，还有支书的威严下，只得点头应下来，反正除了这十块钱，自己身上还有不少钱，也足够自己娶媳妇的了。

只是，赵瞎子感觉自己的心怎么在滴血。

这可是十块钱啊！

周围村民见状，脸上纷纷流露出一抹羡慕之色，甚至恨不得现在上去也让赵瞎子攮一刀！

那可是十块钱啊！

要是买了玉米面，能买一百来斤，配合上一些野菜之类的东西，能让一家子吃上两个月的。

要是一个月买一斤猪肉解馋的话。

能连续解馋两年半呢！

"Five dollars isn't enough?"

"Li Qingshan, you are like a lion, seven yuan, can you do it for seven yuan?"

Blind Zhao gritted his teeth and added another two yuan, feeling extremely distressed. Two yuan, a pound of Shaoguo wine only costs one yuan a pound, a pound of brown sugar only costs six cents, and a pound of pork only costs four cents!!

"Ten dollars, not even a penny less!"

Li Qingshan shook his head and said.

Blind Zhao's family has money, which Li Qingshan didn't expect. He originally thought that Blind Zhao was a pauper, so he thought of sending him to reeducation through labor, but he didn't expect that this guy could still afford it?

If that's the case, then squeeze it.

He is also short of money now, so it is really good to be able to squeeze out ten yuan. If he asks for too much, Zhao Xiazi will definitely send him to reeducation through labor, and Zhou Gongan just said it a little too harshly.

If this kind of thing fails, there will be no injuries. In fact, two or three months of reeducation through labor is a high probability.

However, today’s affairs are not over yet!

Blind Zhao needs to be dealt with properly.

"What are you holding back? Just agree!"

Party Secretary Zhao kicked Blind Zhao on the butt and yelled in a majestic tone.

As long as Blind Zhao is not taken away and his face has not fallen to the ground, why are he still dawdling at this time? He can just pay the money quickly. The compensation is not his own money anyway.

"Okay, okay, ten dollars, just ten dollars!"

Blind Zhao gritted his teeth. Under the fear of half a year of reeducation through labor and the majesty of the party secretary, he had no choice but to nod and accept. Anyway, besides these ten yuan, he still had a lot of money, which was enough to marry him.

However, Blind Zhao felt that his heart was bleeding.

This is ten dollars!

When the surrounding villagers saw this, they all showed a look of envy on their faces, and they even wished that they could kill Blind Zhao now!

That’s ten dollars!

If you buy cornmeal, you can buy about a hundred kilograms, and with some wild vegetables and the like, it can feed the family for two months.

If you buy a pound of pork a month to satisfy your craving.

I can satisfy my craving for two and a half years continuously!
